Echo in the Night of the
Bumblebee Bat

Help mommy bat hunt bugs in the dark, escape from danger and fly back to the cave, where her baby is waiting.

Fly!Move your finger up and down. On a keyboard, use the arrows.
Echo!Tap ECHO to see in the dark. The bugs glow and she catches them.
Watch out!ZIGZAG against the hawk. HIDE against the owl. If her energy runs out, you lose.

The baby can fly now!
★★★

Great hunter!

This is what a real bumblebee bat looks like!
TinyIt is as long as your thumb and weighs less than a penny: the smallest mammal.
EchoIt makes very high-pitched calls and listens to the echo to "see" in the dark.
Forest friendIt eats mosquitoes and little bugs. It only lives in caves in Thailand and Myanmar.

Don't disturb its caves and take care of the forests: that is how we protect it.

Real sounds: tokay gecko (Rling, Wikimedia Commons, public domain); brown wood owl (Shyamal, Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 4.0); bat hawk (Mike Nelson, xeno-canto XC244201, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0); bat echolocation and feeding buzz, 10 times slower (Kaldari, Wikimedia Commons, CC0); bat calls (AvsoftBioAcoustics, Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 3.0); river (stephan, Wikimedia Commons, public domain). There are no free recordings of the bumblebee bat, so other bats are used.

Out of energy

Mommy bat got tired!

She needs to eat bugs to have energy. Tap ECHO to find them in the dark and escape from danger.
